<string name="breath_proto_four_seven_eight_edu">经典 4-7-8：安静鼻吸 4、屏 7、长口呼 8。常用于放松。先做几轮；头晕即停。</string>

<string name="breath_proto_four_seven_eight_edu">Классика 4-7-8: тихий носовой вдох 4, задержка 7, длинный выдох ртом 8. Часто для замедления. Начните с нескольких циклов; остановитесь при лёгкой голове.</string>

<string name="breath_proto_four_seven_eight_edu">Clássico 4-7-8: inspiração nasal calma 4, retenção 7, expiração longa pela boca 8. Muitas vezes para abrandar. Começa com poucos ciclos; para se te sentires leve na cabeça.</string>

<string name="breath_proto_four_seven_eight_edu">Klasyczne 4-7-8: cichy wdech nosem 4, wstrzymanie 7, długi wydech ustami 8. Często do wyciszenia. Zacznij od kilku cykli; przerwij przy zawrotach.</string>

<string name="breath_proto_four_seven_eight_edu">Classique 4-7-8 : inspiration nasale calme 4, rétention 7, longue expiration par la bouche 8. Souvent pour redescendre. Commencez par quelques cycles ; arrêtez si tête légère.</string>

<string name="breath_proto_four_seven_eight_edu">Clásico 4-7-8: inhalación nasal quieta 4, retención 7, exhalación larga por la boca 8. Suele usarse para bajar revoluciones. Empieza con pocos ciclos; para si te mareas.</string>

<string name="breath_proto_four_seven_eight_edu">Klassisch 4-7-8: ruhiger Naseneinatem 4, halten 7, langer Mundausatem 8. Oft zum Runterkommen. Mit wenigen Zyklen starten; bei Benommenheit stoppen.</string>

<string name="breath_proto_four_seven_eight_edu">Classic 4-7-8: quiet nasal inhale for 4, hold for 7, long mouth exhale for 8. Often used to wind down. Start with a few cycles; stop if you feel light-headed.</string>
